description: January 20 birthday meaning: Capricorn or Aquarius cusp, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, January 20 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Capricorn or Aquarius. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: January 20 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The 20th of January sits right on the seam between two signs. In most years the Sun is in the final degree of Capricorn, but a late birth hour or certain years tip it into Aquarius, so the birth time matters. Number 2 suggests a mediator, someone who may translate between tradition and reform with unusual patience.

On January 20 the Sun usually sits at about 29° Capricorn, in the third decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Saturn. Around January 19 to January 21 the Sun moves from Capricorn into Aquarius, and people born near that border often feel pulled between tradition and reinvention. The exact crossing shifts from year to year, so your Sun sign depends on the year, the time and the place of birth; a calculated chart is the only firm answer. The blend is frequently described as a practical reformer: someone with Capricorn's patience and respect for structure who also carries Aquarius' independent, future-facing streak, wanting to change the system and to do it properly.

sections.heading: January 20 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one January 20 birthday to the next: it is 1 for 1960, 11 for 1970, 3 for 1980 and 4 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on January 20: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 20 is the 20th day of the year. By January 21, 1 day later, the Sun has usually moved on into Aquarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, January 20 always falls before Lunar New Year, which arrives between January 21 and February 20, so someone born on this date takes the animal of the previous calendar year. Well-known people born on January 20 include Federico Fellini (1920), André-Marie Ampère (1775) and Buzz Aldrin (1930).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 20?
faq.answer: January 20 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Capricorn or Aquarius on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Capricorn. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 20 the Life Path is 1 in 1960, 11 in 1970, 3 in 1980, 4 in 1990, 5 in 2000, 6 in 2010 and 7 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 20?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology counts the year from Lunar New Year, never earlier than January 21, so a January 20 birthday belongs to the animal of the year before the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 20?
faq.answer: January 20 is also the birthday of Federico Fellini (1920), André-Marie Ampère (1775) and Buzz Aldrin (1930). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
